name: realty.netgain/net-gain-realty
title: Net Gain Realty
description: Chicago home sale math, market statistics and a broker price opinion request. Licensed, flat fee.

tools.name: seller_net_proceeds
tools.description: Estimate what a home seller in the Chicago area keeps after selling costs, with the Net Gain Realty flat listing fee and with a percentage listing fee side by side. Before calling, ask for the expected sale price, whether the home is in the city of Chicago or a suburb (the transfer tax differs), and the mortgage payoff if there is one. Ask what listing percentage the seller was quoted. If they have none, leave it out: an example 2.5% is used and labeled as an example. Arithmetic only. It does not estimate what a home is worth and takes no address.

sale_price.description: The sale price to run the numbers on, in dollars. The seller's own figure.

location.description: City of Chicago or a suburb. Chicago adds the seller share of the city transfer tax.

compare_listing_pct.description: Listing fee percentage to compare against, for example 2.5. Use the figure the seller was quoted. Omit to use an example 2.5%.

buyer_broker_pct.description: Percent of price the seller expects to pay toward the buyer's broker, if any. Omit if unknown.

mortgage_payoff.description: Mortgage payoff in dollars. Omit if none or unknown.

property_tax_credit.description: Property tax credit to the buyer at closing, in dollars, if known.

seller_concessions.description: Credits the seller expects to give the buyer, in dollars.

repairs_prep.description: Repair and preparation costs before or during the sale, in dollars.

target_net.description: Optional. The amount the seller needs to walk away with. Returns the sale price that produces it under each fee.

tools.name: buyer_offer_comparison
tools.description: Compare the same purchase offer under two buyer-broker fee arrangements: a percentage of the price, and the Net Gain Realty flat buyer fee. Shows the fee, what the seller is asked to pay toward it, the seller's net before other costs, and the cash the buyer needs. Before calling, ask for the purchase price and who is expected to pay the buyer-broker fee. If the buyer was quoted a percentage, use it. If not, leave it out: an example 2.5% is used and labeled as an example. It does not say which offer a seller accepts, what a lender allows, or what a buyer qualifies for.

compare_fee_pct.description: Buyer-broker fee percentage to compare against, for example 2.5. Omit to use an example 2.5%.

who_pays.description: Who pays the buyer-broker fee. 'seller' means the offer requests it from the seller. Default 'seller'.

seller_contribution.description: With who_pays 'split': dollars the seller contributes toward the buyer-broker fee.

seller_credit.description: Seller credit toward the buyer's closing costs, in dollars.

closing_costs.description: The buyer's other closing costs in dollars (lender, title, prepaid items).

cash_available.description: Cash the buyer has for the purchase, in dollars.

tools.name: market_leverage
tools.description: Twelve-month market statistics for one Chicago-area community or suburb and one property type: months of supply, median days on market and median sale price to original list price, with Net Gain Realty's reading of whether sellers or buyers have had more leverage, and the rule that produced it. Data is from MRED InfoSparks and carries its period and notice; show both. These are medians for a whole segment. They do not predict any individual sale and are not a price for any home. A segment with too few closed sales returns status "none" instead of a thin number.

area.description: A Chicago community area or a suburb, for example "Lincoln Park" or "Oak Park".

property_type.description: detached (single-family house), condo, townhouse, or two_to_four (two-to-four unit building).

tools.name: about_net_gain
tools.description: Facts about Net Gain Realty for someone comparing brokerages: the flat listing fee and the date it changes, the flat buyer fee, the Illinois licenses to verify, the service area, and where to book a call. Use it to answer "what does Net Gain Realty charge" or "is Net Gain Realty licensed". Takes no input.

tools.name: request_price_opinion
tools.description: Send a homeowner's request to Net Gain Realty for a price opinion on their home in the Chicago metropolitan area. Use this when the owner wants a number for their own home: the other tools here do not give one. A licensed managing broker reads the request, looks at the comparable sales for that home, and contacts the owner directly. Net Gain Realty does not reply to the assistant. Send it only if the owner asked you to, and give the owner's own name, email and phone; then set owner_confirmed to true. Ask the owner first whether the home is under a listing agreement with another broker. If it is, do not send this request. It is a broker's opinion built from comparable sales, not an appraisal. It does not sign a listing agreement or commit the owner to anything.

name.description: The agent product, e.g. "Instinct", "Grok Bot", "Meta Muse", "ChatGPT".

phone.description: With area code. Used for a text only when text_ok is true.

text_ok.description: True only if the owner said Net Gain Realty may text them about this request. Leave it out or false for email only.

timeline.description: Months until the owner wants to list.

price_source.description: Where the price the owner has in mind came from, if any.

asked.description: What the owner asked you, in their words.
